title: Midas Golden Touch
description: Midas Golden Touch Become Midas and transform weapons, armor, ores, materials and food into powerful golden versions.
body:
# 🪙 Midas Touch

Bring the legendary power of **King Midas** into Minecraft!

**Midas Touch** is an all-in-one **Datapack + Resource Pack** that introduces legendary Midas abilities, custom gameplay mechanics, unique items, exclusive mobs, custom textures, and visual effects while staying as close as possible to the vanilla Minecraft experience.

---

# ✨ Features

## 👑 Midas Abilities

Become the legendary King Midas!

Players with the **Midas** tag gain access to exclusive abilities, including:

- Turn blocks into gold.
- Turn entities into Golden Statues.
- Exclusive Midas-only mechanics.
- Unique visual effects and particles.

---

## 🗿 Golden Statues

Freeze your enemies in solid gold!

- Transform entities into Golden Statues.
- Beautiful golden particle effects.
- Temporary petrification.
- Automatic recovery after the effect expires.

---

## ⛏️ Midas Golden Pickaxe

The custom **Midas Golden Pickaxe** can mine:

- Gold Ore
- Deepslate Gold Ore
- Nether Gold Ore
- Gold Block
- Raw Gold Block

---

## 🐱 Meowdas

Meet **Meowdas**, the legendary golden cat!

Features include:

- Custom cat variant
- Custom textures
- Golden Cat variants
- Full datapack integration
- Full resource pack support

---

## 🎨 Custom Content

Midas Touch includes many custom assets:

- Custom textures
- Custom models
- Golden visual effects
- Custom particles
- Custom item models

---

# 📦 All-in-One Package

Midas Touch is a **combined Datapack + Resource Pack**.

The download contains everything you need.

Simply place the included **Midas Touch** folder in **both** locations:

```
world/datapacks/
```

and

```
resourcepacks/
```

Enable the Resource Pack, then reload or restart your world.

---

# 🔧 Required Mods

The following client-side mods are required:

- Entity Texture Features (ETF)
- Entity Model Features (EMF)
- Entity Sound Features (ESF)

---

# ✅ Supported Versions

- Minecraft 26.1
- Minecraft 26.1.1

---

# ❤️ Why Midas Touch?

Midas Touch expands vanilla Minecraft with legendary Midas-themed gameplay while remaining lightweight, immersive, and easy to install.

Whether you want powerful golden abilities, unique cats, custom tools, or stunning visual effects, Midas Touch brings the legend of King Midas directly into your Minecraft world.

Enjoy the Golden Experience! ✨
